consent.title: Before you upload a photo
consent.description: What happens to your photo, how long we keep it, and how to remove it.
consent.next1: The policy body, server-rendered from the current published version.
consent.next2: The accept action, with nothing pre-checked and no visual pressure.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.description: The photos you've saved for trying pieces on. Remove any of them whenever you like.
photos.next1: The saved list with a clear delete on each, and what deleting affects.
photos.next2: The empty state points at adding the first photo, not at the absence of one.

photoNew.title: Add a photo
photoNew.description: A clear, front-facing photo in even light gives the closest guide.
photoNew.next1: Drawn guidance illustrations — never photographs of a person.
photoNew.next2: The client-side validator and the upload, with per-file progress.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name, phone number and the language you prefer.
profile.next1: The profile form, and the event details that shape suggestions.
profile.next2: Phone confirmation, which is only needed before sending an enquiry.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.description: Your password, two-factor authentication, and where you're signed in.
security.next1: Password change, which signs out every other device.
security.next2: The active session list, each one revocable on its own.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what we email or text you about.
notifications.next1: Per-channel preferences, saved as you change them.
notifications.next2: A plain description of what each notification actually says.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Everything stored about you, an export you can download, and deletion.
data.next1: The full picture: profile, photos, try-ons, shortlist, enquiries and consent date.
data.next2: Export and delete, with deletion confirmed by typing, and finished within a day.
